verdict.rationale: Gladia documents first-party audio-intelligence features that produce AI-generated insights from a user's own audio: it runs LLMs directly on audio without a third-party service, extracts sentiment and emotion, and enriches transcripts. These are one-line claims delivered as API outputs, with no detail on what insights are produced or how they are surfaced to users. missing for 10: detailed docs on LLM-generated insights (e.g. summaries or prompts on audio), any AI suggestions or recommendations, an in-product insights surface beyond API output, independent or hands-on corroboration.
